item.title: How subany.video works: live subtitles in the browser
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description: subany.video is a small experiment with a deliberately narrow promise: paste a Twitch link and watch the stream with translated subtitles. The video, the speech recognition and the translation all run in the browser.
